name: 70520 · Carencro, LA
findings: ZIP 70520 (Carencro) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70520 (Carencro) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 70520 (Carencro) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
